import numpy as np

result = multinomial_proportions_confint(counts, 0.05, method='sison-glaz')

# Check if bounds are valid: in [0, 1] and lower <= upper
lower = result[:, 0]
upper = result[:, 1]
point_est = np.array(counts) / sum(counts)

# Record: has NaN, has out of bounds, has point est outside interval
has_nan = float(np.any(np.isnan(result)))
has_out_of_bounds = float(np.any((lower < 0) | (upper > 1)))
has_point_outside = float(np.any((point_est < lower) | (point_est > upper)))

probe('has_point_outside', has_point_outside)
